text:
Jules (Sales): Heads up — Prospect 'VectorWorks' submitted a CAIQ and asked for a POC in EMEA. Intake created.
SecurityBot: New security intake ID SI-2026-173 created by Jules. Link: https://intranet/sec/si-2026-173
Ravi (AE): Thanks. They want a 2-week POC with dedicated capacity and E2E encryption. Pricing estimate needed — will we charge for reserved nodes? :thinking_face:
Lina (SalesOps): For Dedicated POC we usually apply a short-term reserved uplift (15%) + POC support fee. I'll confirm numbers.
Maya (Security Eng): Skimming the CAIQ — gaps around KMS key rotation and external pen-test attestations. Need SOC2/ISO certs and KMS design diagram.
Carson (Solutions Eng): For POC we can put them on Private (VPC) or Dedicated. Private requires network setup; timeline ~5 business days.
Jules (Sales): Can we ship certs and architecture diagram before pricing? Customer expects both by EOD Fri.
Maya (Security Eng): I can export SOC2 summary and KMS diagram. Also requesting clarifications in CAIQ 2.1: Q3, Q8, Q12.
Grace (Legal): If they want KMS key control we need to confirm if customer-managed keys are required — that changes legal T&Cs.
Ravi (AE): I asked the buyer — they said "customer-managed key preferred but not mandatory." I'll push for KMS choice.
Maya (Security Eng): Draft response for CAIQ comments:
```
Q3: We enforce AES-256 at rest and support CMEK via KMS integrations.
Q8: Quarterly penetration tests; summary provided; full reports on NDA.
Q12: Incident response runbook and contact — available on request.
```
Jules (Sales): Action items: Maya upload artifacts, Lina confirm POC pricing uplift, Grace confirm CMEK legal language. Ravi to confirm CMEK requirement with buyer. Carson to estimate network lead time.
Lina (SalesOps): Pricing note: estimate 15% uplift + $3k POC support. I'll post formal quote by tomorrow.
Maya (Security Eng): Uploaded artifacts to GH: https://internal.artifacts/sec/si-2026-173 (SOC2 summary, KMS diagram, CAIQ replies)
Ravi (AE): Buyer replied — they will accept hosted Dedicated with CMEK later. Proceeding with quote. :tada:
Jules (Sales): Thanks everyone — moving to "assigned" on our side. Ping me if anything blocks.
SecurityBot: Intake SI-2026-173 status changed to assigned by Jules.
Carson (Solutions Eng): Note: If they request private deployment during POC extra 3 days for firewall rules.
Grace (Legal): Will draft the CMEK clause and share a redline by EOD tomorrow.
Jules (Sales): Closing loop — next update in morning sync.
